slides.etiqueta: 5 lies you've been told about your testosterone

slides.texto:
Testosterone drops ~1% a year from your 30s–40s. Slowly.
What really tanks it: poor sleep, belly fat, stress and sitting all day.
Age isn't the problem.

Lab ranges are a population average: they include sedentary, overweight and sick men.
In range doesn't mean doing well. Your symptoms, free testosterone and SHBG matter.

slides.etiqueta: LIE 3: “Do more cardio and eat less.”
slides.texto:
Excessive cardio can lower your testosterone.
An aggressive deficit for months does too.
You're feeding the problem.

Tribulus, maca, “boosters”… The evidence is weak.
Vitamin D or zinc only help if you're low. Bloodwork tells you that, not an ad.

slides.etiqueta: LIE 5: “Get on TRT and it's all fixed.”
slides.texto:
If you don't fix sleep, belly fat and habits, no hormone makes up for it.
TRT is a medical decision, not an Instagram one.
Build the foundation first.
